title: Starter agent guide makes tao review part of the edit loop
observed: Every created project tells its agent to "Use `tao review` when visual scenarios changed", calls Scenarios.tao "Studio scenarios", and mentions preparing TestFlight or App Store delivery; review and Studio are release 3 and ship release 5.
impact: The default agent loop in every release-1 project invokes a command the CLI does not offer.
expected: The starter guide describes the loop available in the installed release.
recheck: Follow the guide in a project created by a release-1 CLI.
notes: Source documentation repair implemented and reviewed in the staged-release QA slice. This is source evidence only; the finding stays unresolved until its original acceptance recheck is completed: Follow the guide in a project created by a release-1 CLI.
